title: Prepare new source-grounded WP1 narrative adjudication challenges and preserve review 0124
body:
## Goal
Prepare a bounded public-development challenge package for the remaining C1 narrative-adjudication gap, extending existing WP1 evidence rather than revising the closed key. First report the observed C1 boundary and missing evidence; then prepare new cases and a reproducible adjudication procedure. Expected gain: actual raw prose submissions with source-grounded, separately recorded correctness and grounding expectations, ready for a separate checker session and eventual human use. This session authors expectations; it does not perform human adjudication or certify arbitrary prose. Preserve #594's exact review as supporting evidence without replaying its completed review. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no native validity, behavior, build, dependency resolution or save-version preservation. No product, evaluator, trial arms or readiness promotion.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Verify staged .session/inputs/594-wp1-key-review-0124.json is 126735 bytes with SHA256 23369a95a2c6a847dbe0bf09c9e19dc04c36b7a75269f03018dcbb6e282076a6 before using it. Preserve exact bytes as benchmark/writing/wp1-key-review-0124.json. Record original release iter-0124/594-wp1-key-review-0124.json, issue, observed pins and scope in the new package. If missing or mismatched, save evidence and identify the blocker; never synthesize a substitute review.
- [ ] Before authoring, save benchmark/writing/c1-challenges-0125-findings.md with observed HEAD/tree, protected-source hashes, exact C1 authority pointers, what existing fixed controls establish, and what remains unmeasured. Distinguish human adjudication from independent agent review and scripted integrity. Read the preserved review's relevant limitations and recommendation; do not rerun closed probes.
- [ ] Add benchmark/writing/c1-challenges-0125-cases.json containing raw UTF-8 prose, unique new IDs, exact answer hashes and explicit shared workspace/evidence conditions. Add a separate c1-challenges-0125-expectations.json with atom-level source-based rationales and per-ID correctness/grounding plus separate whole-answer assessments. Cover equivalent conjunction/paraphrase, omission with a true extra, resolvable but non-supporting citation, duplicate assertions, contradiction, unverified extra, and honest abstention. Use fresh wording rather than copying historical answers. Include a supported positive comparator and discriminating cases that prevent a keyword/structured-flag-only pass. Do not claim these cases are withheld or model-unseen. Keep cases and expectations separate to support later ordered reads, without claiming repository paths enforce isolation.
- [ ] For every assertion retain exact subject/property/value/conditions, required-ID mapping, original/output evidence locators, citation-support decision, missing slots, extras, duplicates and contradictions as applicable. Apply existing dimension and precedence rules without weakening preservation or inventory obligations. Any authored expected output is conditional text preparation, never produced agent/native output. Unavailable dependency, runtime and save-version evidence remains unavailable; no invented support or inferred sidecars.
- [ ] Add c1-challenges-0125.md with a practical adjudicator procedure: freeze raw submissions and source pins, independently atomize before consulting expectations, assess correctness and grounding separately, account for all required slots/extras/duplicates/contradictions, preserve disagreements and uncertainty, and record identity/exposure. Provide a blank recording template and exact next-session inputs/order. State that a later independent agent check can test usability but cannot supply a human result; human execution and owner acceptance remain pending. Propose no quality threshold or readiness pass.
- [ ] Add a small repository-only check_c1_challenges_0125.py and c1-challenges-0125-verification.json. The checker validates package structure, raw-answer hashes, source pins, locator resolution, preservation of protected files and separate-dimension accounting; it must not pretend to score arbitrary prose. Include focused rejection checks for corrupted raw bytes, wrong source pins, missing required slots, merged dimensions and unsupported readiness promotion. Run once after inspection, save argv/exit/stdout/stderr, and record the final new-file manifest. Do not execute historical checkers, builders or audits.
- [ ] Modify no preexisting benchmark files: add the preserved review and new 0125 package only. Keep #594 Standards CLEAR / Spec CLEAR scoped to the two conditional IDs; historical F4 slots remain blocked, general established-key/full-trial use remains blocked, C1 human adjudication stays open and benchmark_ready=false. Report author exposure, unexecuted human/native/trial checks, exact output pins and the next independent check. If unfinished, preserve completed work and name the exact missing piece.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_c1_challenges_0125.py
## Context
- #594 review report snapshot df3fae104e59ddf53720a08cad20be21fd34ca9f72c52375602f151e480d52e9: Standards CLEAR / Spec CLEAR for pinned 0123 incorporation and containment only. Detailed evidence arrives as the staged historical input. Reviewed HEAD 6130581ed904692efc3b4b75f6ec5a66c9bcf855/tree f97ab32e9dd03ff273e4ef7fc69c9b60b873bf05; compare scoped bytes, not current HEAD equality.
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md: tasks/oracle/challenges require independent expectations, actual source support and deliberately wrong answers; zero executed trials and missing runtime/key are not passes. Independent method review and owner acceptance still precede product implementation.
- benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.json, comparison_or_human_adjudication and claim_adjudication: human atomic assertions, semantic equivalence, extras, duplicates, contradictions and separate citation-support judgments remain required. Grep by this shaper found the explicit C1 rule and historical prescriptions, not a general narrative scorer.
- benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0123.{md,json}: closed conditional incorporation is inherited evidence, not a reason to revise or rereview it. Preserve two new IDs' conditions and historical outcomes.
- benchmark/writing/README.md:60 and integration-0112-provenance.md:21 retain the C1 boundary; structured checks do not validate arbitrary future answers.
## Budget
Read first: staged .session/inputs/594-wp1-key-review-0124.json via targeted identity/scope/C1/limitations/next-gap queries after byte/hash check; docs/perpetua/evaluation.md whole; benchmark/writing/README.md WP1 clauses; integration-0112-provenance.md C1 paragraph. Authority: benchmark/writing/method.json common answer rule and WP1 task only; benchmark/protocol.md grading and narrative challenge clauses; wp1-key-0119.json claim_adjudication and required-ID dimension tests; wp1-key-0123.md whole and wp1-key-0123.json composition/conditions/new IDs/limits only. Source evidence: benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj and LICENSE.txt; wp1-examples-0121.json conditional workspace, inventories and operative output/map bytes by targeted queries only. Follow exact links only to settle a case. No whole large JSON/base64 dumps, global gap maps, POC/source-absence searches, old history scans, historical probe replay, native execution, agent arms, git commit, shell expansion, pipes or redirection. Keep output short and save findings/package early. Engine verification cannot read .session inputs/artifacts/report or LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT, so the checker must use repository files only.
